description: Is this request really GPTBot, Googlebot or PerplexityBot? Checks an IP address (and optionally the user agent it sent) against the IP lists OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, DuckDuckGo, Common Crawl, Google, Bing and Apple publish. Says whether the bot is verified, fake (claims a bot but comes from elsewhere), disguised (an AI crawler's address sending a browser user agent) or unverifiable (operator publishes no list), and whether pay-per-crawl would charge it. Also checks Web Bot Auth signatures (pass the signature headers): a valid one verifies the agent from any address. Free.

ip.description: The request's IP address, IPv4 or IPv6

signature.description: Web Bot Auth headers to check (RFC 9421 signatures): verified by the agent's published key from any address.

signature_agent.description: The Signature-Agent header, as sent (a quoted string, e.g. "https://chatgpt.com")

url.description: The https URL the request was sent to (its host is the signed @authority)

name: verify_bot
title: Verify a crawler
